description: Ministry of Urban Development and Housing - Publishing of rules Under the Provisions of Construction Industry Development Act, No. 33 of 2014
reasoning: This gazette contains rules made by the Construction Industry Development Authority under the Construction Industry Development Act, establishing regulatory requirements for registration, grading, and certification of importers, manufacturers and suppliers of construction materials. It creates a legal/regulatory framework with compliance requirements, which fits the definition of Legal/Regulatory Gazettes (Type 5).
